title: VCR play
suits: talks and products about video, archives, memory, nostalgia, found footage, retro media, film and storytelling; anything that should feel like a tape someone pressed play on

params.--field: the tape's picture behind the title (any colour or gradient); or put an in .rv-vcr-pic
params.--rv-vcr: the VCR's blue screen before play
params.__WORD__: the title, set as a camcorder title overlay lower left

details: before the press the VCR's blue is perfectly clean: no scanlines, no noise, because the deck generates it, not the tape
PLAY ▶ appears in OSD type the instant the press lands, the ▶ slightly widened like a real deck's glyph
a beat of pure blue (0.6 s) while the heads spin up
a band of tracking noise rolls up from the bottom: streaky rows, brightest in the middle, a magenta or teal line now and then
just under the band the fresh picture tears in a few thin slipped lines
the picture slips two frames of vertical hold (up, then down) and goes still
the title is a camcorder titler overlay: white, heavy, lower left, with a hard drop shadow
the OSD clears at 2.2 s, as decks do a couple of seconds after PLAY
the picture behind the title is softly blurred and sun-faded, so the title stays crisp
